articles.title: Zcash targets November upgrade to make private payments up to three times faster
articles.snippet: NU7 would reduce block times to 25 seconds while setting aside at least 60% of transaction fees to supplement mining rewards beginning in 2031.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs over $80,000 as crypto shakes off Clarity failure and higher interest rates
articles.snippet: Another central bank hiked rates overnight, this time the Bank of Japan. The move failed to halt the slide in the yen.

articles.title: SBI Group backs payments firm dtcpay in $25 million funding round
articles.snippet: Stablecoin payments company dtcpay completed a $25 million Series A funding round with a strategic investment from Japan’s SBI Group.

articles.title: Solana speeds up blocks by 17%, but transaction capacity stays the same
articles.snippet: The network is cutting its target slot time to 250 milliseconds, giving apps fresher blockchain data and validators shorter control windows while reducing the amount of work allowed in each slot.

articles.title: Ethereum Institutional signals support for Ethlabs’ motion to reduce Ethereum block times
articles.snippet: The non-profit signaled support for reducing Ethereum block times, citing increasing institutional activity moving onto the smart-contract network.
